description: This file is a Python script for a sales order analysis report in the ERPNext system. It includes functions for filtering, data retrieval, and chart preparation related to sales orders.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Main function to generate sales order analysis report based on filters.

methods.name: validate_filters
methods.description: Validates the date filters to ensure they are correctly set.

methods.name: get_conditions
methods.description: Builds SQL conditions based on provided filters.

methods.name: get_data
methods.description: Retrieves sales order data from the database with applied conditions.

methods.name: prepare_data
methods.description: Processes raw data for report display and chart data.

methods.name: prepare_chart_data
methods.description: Prepares data for the donut chart visualization.

methods.name: get_columns
methods.description: Defines the columns for the report table based on filters.
